risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic energy producers; monitor OPEC+ response

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; favour dividend-paying defensives

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold exploration and production names
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon, Gateway US$45M drill-out, Forrestania pacts) signal a WA gold cycle; gold price supported by geopolitical risk and Trump uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Favour domestic energy and utilities on security premium
opportunities.rationale: Coal strike, NSW power gap, and data centre demand create structural tailwind for AGL, CGP, WDS; Santos cartel break reshapes gas pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Position in AI infrastructure and data centre plays
opportunities.rationale: Six new Tasmanian data centres and global AI capex cycle (Broadcom, Dell) drive long-term demand; energy transition tension creates pricing power

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to iron ore majors and rate-sensitive REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; RBA recession path and collapsing housing sentiment pressure property and credit

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity beta with gold and quality defensives
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX sliding on oil-driven rate fears; 'war on equities' narrative; business conditions at pandemic lows

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor AUD/USD and China trade flows closely
defensive_moves.rationale: China-Trump escalation and iron ore weakness threaten AUD; commodity-linked currency risk

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX under pressure from oil near US$100, rate-hike repricing, and recession fears. Big four banks and iron ore names lead declines. Gold and energy names provide relative strength. Expect volatility around Iran conflict headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if RBA stabilises and oil normalises. WA gold cycle and AI infrastructure capex offer structural growth. Iron ore remains a structural headwind. Housing correction may deepen before stabilising.
